than 63 cubic feet of maximum cargo

standard with Chevy Safety Assist,3
a comprehensive package of driver
assistance features that offers peace
of mind as you travel.
Add in a spacious interior wrapped
in a stylish exterior and you have a
first-class SUV that’s second to none.
